     1→     1→// ─── Auto trade (dry-run) — scan engine, ranking, position book, Telegram ────
     2→     2→//
     3→     3→// The auto engine answers two questions every cycle:
     4→     4→//   1. WHICH pair × timeframe looks best right now?  → scanAll() trains an
     5→     5→//      XGBoost model for EVERY watched pair on EVERY timeframe and ranks the
     6→     6→//      results by a composite quality score.
     7→     7→//   2. SHOULD a dry-run position be opened/closed?   → the best tradeable row
     8→     8→//      (bias ≠ NEUTRAL, auc/acc above thresholds) is traded with a virtual
     9→     9→//      capital; open positions are checked against SL/TP each cycle.
    10→    10→//
    11→    11→// Scan runs use difficulty 0 so every combo faces the SAME task — a fair
    12→    12→// ranking. Manual "Train" still persists + bumps difficulty per pair.
    13→    13→
    14→    14→import type { EngineSettings, Kline } from "./types";
    15→    15→import { INTERVALS } from "./types";
    16→    16→import { biasFrom, runXgb, type WhaleReadout, type WhaleTag, type XgbBias, type XgbResult } from "./xgb";
    17→    17→import { LLM_MODEL_DEFAULT, LLM_URL_DEFAULT, type LlmSetup } from "./llm";
    18→    18→import {
    19→    19→  CONF_W,
    20→    20→  NEAR_FRAC,
    21→    21→  NOISE_BAND,
    22→    22→  PROB_CAP,
    23→    23→  REGRESS_EPS,
    24→    24→  SIBLING_DISCOUNT,
    25→    25→  pval,
    26→    26→} from "./params";
    27→    27→
    28→    28→// Knob sống ở ./params — MỘT nguồn config; re-export cho chỗ cũ không đổi path.
    29→    29→export { CONF_W, NEAR_FRAC, REGRESS_EPS } from "./params";
    30→    30→import { fmtPrice } from "./i18n";
    31→    31→
    32→    32→// ─── Scan rows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    33→    33→
    34→    34→export interface ScanRow {
    35→    35→  symbol: string;
    36→    36→  interval: string;
    37→    37→  acc: number;
    38→    38→  auc: number;
    39→    39→  prob: number;
    40→    40→  confidence: number;
    41→    41→  bias: XgbBias;
    42→    42→  slPct: number;
    43→    43→  tpPct: number;
    44→    44→  /** ATR multiplier retrained for this coin — live "atr" entries re-apply it at entry time */
    45→    45→  atrCoef: number;
    46→    46→  score: number;
    47→    47→  samples: number;
    48→    48→  valSamples: number;
    49→    49→  horizon: number;
    50→    50→  trainedAt: number;
    51→    51→  /** whale footprint at the last closed candle — auto-entry skips "whale" */
    52→    52→  whale: WhaleReadout;
    53→    53→  /** best-ever run of this combo (from the FinetuneRun history) — 0 = no history */
    54→    54→  champAuc: number;
    55→    55→  champAcc: number;
    56→    56→  /** this retrain rolled measurably worse than the combo's best-ever model —
    57→    57→   *  auto-entry skips it until a train matches the champion again */
    58→    58→  regressed: boolean;
    59→    59→}
    60→    60→
    61→    61→/**
    62→    62→ * Composite quality score — "how much do we trust this model's edge":
    63→    63→ *   (auc − 0.5) × 100   rank quality beyond a coin flip
    64→    64→ * + (acc − 50)          validation accuracy beyond a coin flip
    65→    65→ * + confidence × CONF_W how decisively the model leans at the last candle
    66→    66→ * (CONF_W = 15 trong params.ts §7 — prob đầu vào đã qua calibration §6c,
    67→    67→ *  nên "confidence" là số trung thực, không còn kiểu 86% chỉ để rồi thắng 60%.)
    68→    68→ */
    69→    69→export const scoreFrom = (auc: number, acc: number, confidence: number): number =>
    70→    70→  Math.round(((auc - 0.5) * 100 + (acc - 50) + confidence * pval("CONF_W", CONF_W)) * 10) / 10;
    71→    71→
    72→    72→export function scoreOf(res: XgbResult): number {
    73→    73→  return scoreFrom(res.auc, res.acc, res.suggestion.confidence);
    74→    74→}
    75→    75→
    76→    76→export function rowOf(res: XgbResult, symbol: string, interval: string): ScanRow {
    77→    77→  return {
    78→    78→    symbol,
    79→    79→    interval,
    80→    80→    acc: res.acc,
    81→    81→    auc: res.auc,
    82→    82→    prob: res.suggestion.prob,
    83→    83→    confidence: res.suggestion.confidence,
    84→    84→    bias: res.suggestion.bias,
    85→    85→    slPct: res.suggestion.slPct,
    86→    86→    tpPct: res.suggestion.tpPct,
    87→    87→    atrCoef: res.suggestion.atrCoef ?? 1.5,
    88→    88→    score: scoreOf(res),
    89→    89→    samples: res.samples,
    90→    90→    valSamples: res.valSamples,
    91→    91→    horizon: res.horizon,
    92→    92→    trainedAt: Date.now(),
    93→    93→    whale: res.whale ?? { volZ: 0, risk: 0, tag: "calm" as WhaleTag },
    94→    94→    champAuc: 0,
    95→    95→    champAcc: 0,
    96→    96→    regressed: false,
    97→    97→  };
    98→    98→}
    99→    99→
   100→   100→/** Cổng tradeable dùng chung MỌI tầng: mở lệnh, bù DCA, best-pick. minScore = 0
   101→   101→ *  nghĩa là không chấm điểm (giữ backward-compat cho test); engine luôn truyền
   102→   102→ *  ngưỡng chung cfg.minScore. Model dưới ngưỡng nào trong ba (AUC/ACC/Điểm) thì đứng
   103→   103→ *  ngoài — một setpoint duy nhất, không có ngưỡng riêng thứ hai. */
   104→   104→export const isTradeable = (r: ScanRow, minAuc: number, minAcc: number, minScore = 0): boolean =>
   105→   105→  r.bias !== "NEUTRAL" && r.auc >= minAuc && r.acc >= minAcc && (minScore <= 0 || r.score >= minScore);
   106→   106→
   107→   107→export const rankRows = (rows: ScanRow[]): ScanRow[] => [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
   108→   108→
   109→   109→export const bestTradeable = (rows: ScanRow[], minAuc: number, minAcc: number, minScore = 0): ScanRow | null =>
   110→   110→  rankRows(rows.filter((r) => isTradeable(r, minAuc, minAcc, minScore)))[0] ?? null;
   111→   111→
   112→   112→/**
   113→   113→ * Chọn setup THẬT cho nút "Duyệt thử" (test LLM) thay vì setup giả mid-strength:
   114→   114→ * ứng viên tốt nhất hiện có trong scan gần nhất của engine, lọc ĐÚNG như
   115→   115→ * auto-cycle (gate minAuc/minAcc/minScore + không regressed + noise band).
   116→   116→ * Không ứng viên nào đạt gate → rơi về top scan có hướng LONG/SHORT, kèm nhãn
   117→   117→ * "CHƯA đạt gate" để user biết engine thực tế sẽ KHÔNG gửi combo này đi.
   118→   118→ * Scan rỗng/toàn NEUTRAL → null (caller dùng setup giả mẫu làm phương án cuối).
   119→   119→ */
   120→   120→export function llmTestSetup(
   121→   121→  rows: ScanRow[],
   122→   122→  cfg: Pick<AutoConfig, "minAuc" | "minAcc" | "minScore" | "tpMode" | "slPct" | "tpPct" | "riskPct">,
   123→   123→  leverage: number,
   124→   124→): { setup: LlmSetup; source: string } | null {
   125→   125→  const cands = rows.filter(
   126→   126→    (r) => isTradeable(r, cfg.minAuc, cfg.minAcc, cfg.minScore) && !r.regressed && Math.abs(r.prob - 0.5) >= pval("NOISE_BAND", NOISE_BAND),
   127→   127→  );
   128→   128→  const pick = rankRows(cands)[0] ?? rankRows(rows.filter((r) => r.bias !== "NEUTRAL"))[0] ?? null;
   129→   129→  if (!pick) return null;
   130→   130→  const gated = cands.includes(pick);
   131→   131→  const setup: LlmSetup = {
   132→   132→    symbol: pick.symbol,
   133→   133→    interval: pick.interval,
   134→   134→    side: pick.bias as "LONG" | "SHORT",
   135→   135→    prob: pick.prob,
   136→   136→    confidence: pick.confidence,
   137→   137→    auc: pick.auc,
   138→   138→    acc: pick.acc,
   139→   139→    slPct: cfg.tpMode === "manual" ? cfg.slPct : pick.slPct,
   140→   140→    tpPct: cfg.tpMode === "manual" ? cfg.tpPct : pick.tpPct,
   141→   141→    leverage,
   142→   142→    stakePct: cfg.riskPct,
   143→   143→    horizon: pick.horizon,
   144→   144→    samples: pick.samples,
   145→   145→    score: pick.score,
   146→   146→    gatePassed: gated,
   147→   147→    // champion–challenger — "Duyệt thử" nhìn thấy Y HỆT những gì engine gửi:
   148→   148→    // kể cả khoảng cách tới đỉnh best-ever của cặp này (champ_check)
   149→   149→    ...(pick.champAuc ? { champAuc: pick.champAuc, champAcc: pick.champAcc } : {}),
   150→   150→  };
   151→   151→  const id = `${pick.symbol} ${pick.interval}`;
   152→   152→  return {
   153→   153→    setup,
   154→   154→    source: gated
   155→   155→      ? `REAL setup — the engine's best current candidate: ${id} · score ${pick.score.toFixed(1)} · gate passed`
   156→   156→      : `REAL setup — top of scan: ${id} · score ${pick.score.toFixed(1)} · gate NOT passed (no candidate above the gate yet)`,
   157→   157→  };
   158→   158→}
   159→   159→
   160→   160→// ─── Confluence pooling — các model train riêng của CÙNG symbol vote chung ───
   161→   161→// Trước đây mỗi combo (symbol × khung) là một hòn đảo: BTC 15m và BTC 1h train
   162→   162→// riêng, chấm riêng, không biết nhau tồn tại. Nhưng chúng là những bằng chứng
   163→   163→// về CÙNG chiều giá — ghép lại bằng log-odds pooling (Naive-Bayes):
   164→   164→//
   165→   165→//   p_pool = sigmoid( ( w_self·logit(p_self) + Σ λ·wⱼ·logit(pⱼ) ) / ( w_self + Σ λ·wⱼ ) )
   166→   166→//   wᵢ = max(0.2, (aucᵢ − 0.5) × 4)    model yếu → phiếu nhẹ
   167→   167→//   phiếu từ khung KHÁC × λ = 0.5       các khung correlate, không độc lập hoàn toàn
   168→   168→//
   169→   169→// prob LUÔN là P(giá đi lên) nên dấu logit tự mã hóa hướng — pool thô trong
   170→   170→// một hệ quy chiếu duy nhất, KHÔNG map theo phía từng row. Các khung cùng
   171→   171→// hướng → |logit| cộng dồn → Prob tổng đội lên thật sự; lệch hướng → các
   172→   172→// logit triệt tiêu nhau → xả về 0.5 → bias NEUTRAL → không trade. Model
   173→   173→// NEUTRAL (prob ≈ 0.5) tự động bỏ phiếu trắng vì logit(0.5) = 0. An toàn:
   174→   174→// bất đồng quá mức có thể kéo prob vắt qua 0.5 → kẹp về đúng 0.5 (KHÔNG lật
   175→   175→// chiều call của model gốc — hội đồng bất đồng thì đứng ngoài), và prob cuối
   176→   176→// kẹp [0.05, 0.95] — bỏ phiếu correlate không được biến thành tuyệt đối.
   177→   177→// prob/confidence/bias/score sau ghép dùng ĐÚNG công thức gốc (biasFrom,
   178→   178→// |p−0.5|×2, scoreFrom) — vẫn chỉ một thuật toán. SIBLING_DISCOUNT + PROB_CAP
   179→   179→// sống ở ./params (nhóm CONFLUENCE) để finetune một chỗ.
   180→   180→
   181→   181→const logitC = (p: number): number => {
   182→   182→  const q = Math.min(0.98, Math.max(0.02, p)); // chống ±∞ ở đầu mút
   183→   183→  return Math.log(q / (1 - q));
   184→   184→};
   185→   185→const sigmoid = (x: number): number => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-x));
   186→   186→
   187→   187→export function confluenceBlend(rows: ScanRow[]): ScanRow[] {
   188→   188→  const bySym = new Map<string, ScanRow[]>();
   189→   189→  for (const r of rows) {
   190→   190→    const l = bySym.get(r.symbol);
   191→   191→    if (l) l.push(r);
   192→   192→    else bySym.set(r.symbol, [r]);
   193→   193→  }
   194→   194→  const out = rows.map((r) => ({ ...r }));
   195→   195→  const outByKey = new Map(out.map((r) => [`${r.symbol}|${r.interval}`, r]));
   196→   196→  for (const group of bySym.values()) {
   197→   197→    if (group.length < 2) continue; // không có anh em cùng symbol → giữ nguyên
   198→   198→    for (const r of group) {
   199→   199→      const dev = r.prob - 0.5;
   200→   200→      const band = pval("NOISE_BAND", NOISE_BAND);
   201→   201→      if (Math.abs(dev) < band) continue; // row tự thân coin-flip → không mượn phiếu
   202→   202→      const side = dev > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   203→   203→      const wSelf = Math.max(0.2, (r.auc - 0.5) * 4);
   204→   204→      let num = wSelf * logitC(r.prob);
   205→   205→      let den = wSelf;
   206→   206→      for (const s of group) {
   207→   207→        if (s === r) continue;
   208→   208→        const w = Math.max(0.2, (s.auc - 0.5) * 4) * pval("SIBLING_DISCOUNT", SIBLING_DISCOUNT);
   209→   209→        num += w * logitC(s.prob); // dấu logit tự mã hóa hướng — pool thô
   210→   210→        den += w;
   211→   211→      }
   212→   212→      const pooled = sigmoid(num / den);
   213→   213→      // bất đồng quá mức có thể kéo prob vắt qua 0.5 — không bao giờ lật chiều
   214→   214→      // call của model gốc: kẹp về đúng 0.5 → bias NEUTRAL → đứng ngoài cuộc
   215→   215→      const kept = side > 0 ? Math.max(pooled, 0.5) : Math.min(pooled, 0.5);
   216→   216→      const cap = pval("PROB_CAP", PROB_CAP);
   217→   217→      const row = outByKey.get(`${r.symbol}|${r.interval}`)!;
   218→   218→      row.prob = Math.round(Math.min(cap, Math.max(1 - cap, kept)) * 10_000) / 10_000;
   219→   219→      row.confidence = Math.abs(row.prob - 0.5) * 2; // công thức gốc xgb.ts
   220→   220→      row.bias = biasFrom(row.prob); // ngưỡng chết gốc 0.56/0.44
   221→   221→      row.score = scoreFrom(row.auc, row.acc, row.confidence);
   222→   222→    }
   223→   223→  }
   224→   224→  return out;
   225→   225→}
   226→   226→
   227→   227→/**
   228→   228→ * Pick the best tradeable row whose combo is NOT in an SL cooldown. A combo
   229→   229→ * that just stopped out tends to stay hostile — re-entering it immediately is
   230→   230→ * how dry-run books bleed. Cooldown 0 disables the check entirely.
   231→   231→ * trades must be newest-first (as /api/autotrade returns them).
   232→   232→ */
   233→   233→export function slCooldownLeft(
   234→   234→  trades: AutoTradeRow[],
   235→   235→  symbol: string,
   236→   236→  interval: string,
   237→   237→  cooldownMin: number,
   238→   238→  now = Date.now(),
   239→   239→): number {
   240→   240→  if (cooldownMin <= 0) return 0;
   241→   241→  const last = trades.find(
   242→   242→    (t) => t.status === "closed" && t.exitKind === "sl" && t.symbol === symbol && t.interval === interval,
   243→   243→  );
   244→   244→  if (!last?.exitTime) return 0;
   245→   245→  const end = new Date(last.exitTime).getTime() + cooldownMin * 60_000;
   246→   246→  return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((end - now) / 60_000));
   247→   247→}
   248→   248→
   249→   249→/** The newest SL-closed trade of a combo (newest-first trades), if any. */
   250→   250→export function lastSlExit(
   251→   251→  trades: AutoTradeRow[],
   252→   252→  symbol: string,
   253→   253→  interval: string,
   254→   254→): AutoTradeRow | null {
   255→   255→  return trades.find(
   256→   256→    (t) => t.status === "closed" && t.exitKind === "sl" && t.symbol === symbol && t.interval === interval,
   257→   257→  ) ?? null;
   258→   258→}
   259→   259→
   260→   260→/**
   261→   261→ * Chase guard — the "SL xong vào lại giá cao hơn" blocker.
   262→   262→ * After an SL exit on the SAME combo, a same-side re-entry is only allowed
   263→   263→ * once the price has reversed back through the exit level (SHORT: price is
   264→   264→ * back BELOW the level that stopped us; LONG: back ABOVE it). Re-entering a
   265→   265→ * SHORT at/above the stop that just fired is fighting the move that broke the
   266→   266→ * thesis — bleed by a thousand cuts. An OPPOSITE-side entry is a fresh thesis
   267→   267→ * and always passes.
   268→   268→ */
   269→   269→export function passesChaseGuard(
   270→   270→  trades: AutoTradeRow[],
   271→   271→  symbol: string,
   272→   272→  interval: string,
   273→   273→  side: string,
   274→   274→  price: number,
   275→   275→): boolean {
   276→   276→  const last = lastSlExit(trades, symbol, interval);
   277→   277→  if (!last?.exitPrice || !price) return true;
   278→   278→  if (side !== last.side) return true; // bias flipped → fresh thesis
   279→   279→  const eps = last.exitPrice * 1e-6;
   280→   280→  return side === "SHORT" ? price < last.exitPrice - eps : price > last.exitPrice + eps;
   281→   281→}
   282→   282→
   283→   283→/** AUC drop vs the combo's champion that marks a retrain as a regression —
   284→   284→ *  giá trị sống ở ./params (re-export đầu file). */
   285→   285→
   286→   286→/** Attach the combo's champion metrics to a fresh scan row (+ regression flag). */
   287→   287→export function withChampion(r: ScanRow, champAuc: number, champAcc: number): ScanRow {
   288→   288→  return {
   289→   289→    ...r,
   290→   290→    champAuc,
   291→   291→    champAcc,
   292→   292→    regressed: champAuc > 0 && r.auc < champAuc - pval("REGRESS_EPS", REGRESS_EPS),
   293→   293→  };
   294→   294→}
   295→   295→
   296→   296→export function bestTradeableAvoid(
   297→   297→  rows: ScanRow[],
   298→   298→  minAuc: number,
   299→   299→  minAcc: number,
   300→   300→  trades: AutoTradeRow[],
   301→   301→  cooldownMin: number,
   302→   302→  whaleFilter = true,
   303→   303→  /** XGBoost noise band — skip coin-flip probs (|P−0.5| < band); 0 = off */
   304→   304→  noiseBand = pval("NOISE_BAND", NOISE_BAND),
   305→   305→  /** ngưỡng điểm của cùng bộ setpoint chung — 0 = không chấm điểm */
   306→   306→  minScore = 0,
   307→   307→): { best: ScanRow | null; allInCooldown: boolean; cands: ScanRow[]; regressedCount: number } {
   308→   308→  // whaleFilter (default on) skips combos whose last closed candle is a full
   309→   309→  // whale bar (≥4σ volume) — entries opened into those get wicked out.
   310→   310→  // noiseBand skips model probs with no decisive lean (0.5 ± band) — the
   311→   311→  // XGBoost denoiser: an undecided model is statistical noise, not a signal.
   312→   312→  // regressed combos (this retrain measurably worse than the combo's champion)
   313→   313→  // never trade — no gambling on a bad roll.
   314→   314→  const cands = rankRows(
   315→   315→    rows.filter(
   316→   316→      (r) =>
   317→   317→        isTradeable(r, minAuc, minAcc, minScore) &&
   318→   318→        !r.regressed &&
   319→   319→        (!whaleFilter || r.whale?.tag !== "whale") &&
   320→   320→        (noiseBand <= 0 || Math.abs(r.prob - 0.5) >= noiseBand),
   321→   321→    ),
   322→   322→  );
   323→   323→  const regressedCount = rows.filter((r) => isTradeable(r, minAuc, minAcc, minScore) && r.regressed).length;
   324→   324→  const free = cands.find((r) => slCooldownLeft(trades, r.symbol, r.interval, cooldownMin) === 0) ?? null;
   325→   325→  return { best: free, allInCooldown: free == null && cands.length > 0, cands, regressedCount };
   326→   326→}
   327→   327→
   328→   328→// ─── Auto-flip — thị trường luôn biến động, dự báo chỉ là dự báo ─────────────
   329→   329→// Khi lệnh đang mở mà scan mới của CÙNG cặp/khung đảo chiều với tín hiệu ĐỦ
   330→   330→// TIN CẬY (cùng ngưỡng chất lượng với vào lệnh + noise band + không regressed +
   331→   331→// sạch nến whale), engine lật lệnh NGAY thay vì ôm chiều cũ đến SL/TP. Hàm
   332→   332→// này là bộ LOẠI thuần (không IO) — engine gọi rồi tự đóng/mở; test chạy thẳng.
   333→   333→
   334→   334→export interface FlipDecision {
   335→   335→  /** true = đủ điều kiện lật chiều */
   336→   336→  ok: boolean;
   337→   337→  /** lý do KHÔNG lật (khi ok=false) — log + status line, không âm thầm */
   338→   338→  why: string;
   339→   339→}
   340→   340→
   341→   341→/**
   342→   342→ * Đủ tin cậy để lật chiều lệnh `open` theo scan row `row` (CÙNG symbol+interval)?
   343→   343→ *  • row phải có bias NGƯỢC phía lệnh (NEUTRAL = model bỏ cuộc → không lật theo nhiễu)
   344→   344→ *  • cùng NGƯỠNG CHẤT LƯỢNG với vào lệnh: minAuc/minAcc/minScore (isTradeable)
   345→   345→ *  • không regressed vs champion (mỗi lần lật phải tín hiệu thật, không phải model hỏng)
   346→   346→ *  • ngoài noise band |P−0.5| ≥ NOISE_BAND — model dứt khoát, không coin-flip
   347→   347→ *  • whale filter (nếu bật): nến khối lượng ≥4σ là bẫy wick, không lật vào đó
   348→   348→ */
   349→   349→export function flipDecision(
   350→   350→  open: Pick<AutoTradeRow, "symbol" | "interval" | "side">,
   351→   351→  row: ScanRow | undefined,
   352→   352→  cfg: Pick<AutoConfig, "minAuc" | "minAcc" | "minScore" | "whaleFilter">,
   353→   353→): FlipDecision {
   354→   354→  if (!row) return { ok: false, why: "scan has no such combo" };
   355→   355→  if (row.bias === "NEUTRAL") return { ok: false, why: "model is NEUTRAL on the open combo" };
   356→   356→  if (row.bias === open.side) return { ok: false, why: "model still confirms the held side" };
   357→   357→  if (!isTradeable(row, cfg.minAuc, cfg.minAcc, cfg.minScore))
   358→   358→    return {
   359→   359→      ok: false,
   360→   360→      why: `opposite signal below the quality gate (AUC ${row.auc.toFixed(2)} / ACC ${row.acc.toFixed(1)}% / score ${row.score.toFixed(1)})`,
   361→   361→    };
   362→   362→  if (row.regressed) return { ok: false, why: "this combo's model is regressed vs its champion" };
   363→   363→  if (Math.abs(row.prob - 0.5) < pval("NOISE_BAND", NOISE_BAND)) return { ok: false, why: "signal inside the coin-flip noise band" };
   364→   364→  if (cfg.whaleFilter && row.whale?.tag === "whale") return { ok: false, why: "last candle is a whale bar — not flipping into a wick trap" };
   365→   365→  return { ok: true, why: "" };
   366→   366→}
   367→   367→
   368→   368→// ─── Kline fetch + full scan ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
   369→   369→
   370→   370→const sleep = (ms = 0) => new Promise((r) => globalThis.setTimeout(r, ms));
   371→   371→
   372→   372→/** `limit` optional — universe scan passes 240 (10 ngày × nến 1h). */
   373→   373→export async function fetchKlines(symbol: string, interval: string, limit?: number): Promise<Kline[]> {
   374→   374→  const q = limit && limit > 0 ? `&limit=${limit}` : "";
   375→   375→  const res = await fetch(`/api/klines?symbol=${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}&interval=${interval}${q}`);
   376→   376→  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
   377→   377→  const json = (await res.json()) as { klines: Kline[] };
   378→   378→  return json.klines;
   379→   379→}
   380→   380→
   381→   381→export interface ScanProgress {
   382→   382→  done: number;
   383→   383→  total: number;
   384→   384→  current: string;
   385→   385→}
   386→   386→
   387→   387→/**
   388→   388→ * Train a model for EVERY pair × interval combo (sequential so the UI stays
   389→   389→ * alive) and return the ranked scan. Difficulty is pinned to 0 — a fair race.
   390→   390→ * Combos that fail (bad pair, starved dataset) are skipped silently.
   391→   391→ */
   392→   392→export async function scanAll(opts: {
   393→   393→  pairs: string[];
   394→   394→  intervals?: readonly string[];
   395→   395→  settings: EngineSettings;
   396→   396→  onProgress?: (p: ScanProgress) => void;
   397→   397→  shouldAbort?: () => boolean;
   398→   398→}): Promise<ScanRow[]> {
   399→   399→  const intervals = opts.intervals ?? INTERVALS;
   400→   400→  const total = opts.pairs.length * intervals.length;
   401→   401→  const rows: ScanRow[] = [];
   402→   402→  let done = 0;
   403→   403→  for (const symbol of opts.pairs) {
   404→   404→    for (const interval of intervals) {
   405→   405→      if (opts.shouldAbort?.()) return rankRows(rows);
   406→   406→      const label = `${symbol} ${interval}`;
   407→   407→      opts.onProgress?.({ done, total, current: label });
   408→   408→      try {
   409→   409→        const klines = await fetchKlines(symbol, interval);
   410→   410→        // below ~260 candles the model starves (WARMUP 110 + labels) — skip
   411→   411→        if (klines.length >= 260) {
   412→   412→          const res = await runXgb(klines, opts.settings, `${symbol}-${interval}`, interval, undefined, 0);
   413→   413→          rows.push(rowOf(res, symbol, interval));
   414→   414→        }
   415→   415→      } catch {
   416→   416→        // unreachable pair / not enough data → leave this combo out
   417→   417→      }
   418→   418→      done++;
   419→   419→      opts.onProgress?.({ done, total, current: label });
   420→   420→      await sleep(); // yield between combos
   421→   421→    }
   422→   422→  }
   423→   423→  return rankRows(rows);
   424→   424→}
   425→   425→
   426→   426→// ─── Position math ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   427→   427→
   428→   428→/** Signed ROE % of a position at `price` (leverage applied). */
   429→   429→export function roeOf(side: string, entry: number, price: number, leverage: number): number {
   430→   430→  if (!entry || !price) return 0;
   431→   431→  const move = side === "SHORT" ? ((entry - price) / entry) * 100 : ((price - entry) / entry) * 100;
   432→   432→  return Math.round(move * leverage * 100) / 100;
   433→   433→}
   434→   434→
   435→   435→/** "sl" | "tp" | null — has the LIVE price crossed the SL/TP of the position? */
   436→   436→export function slTpHit(side: string, price: number, entry: number, slPct: number, tpPct: number): "sl" | "tp" | null {
   437→   437→  if (!entry || !price) return null;
   438→   438→  const roe = roeOf(side, entry, price, 1); // price-move % (no leverage)
   439→   439→  if (roe <= -Math.abs(slPct)) return "sl";
   440→   440→  if (roe >= Math.abs(tpPct)) return "tp";
   441→   441→  return null;
   442→   442→}
   443→   443→
   444→   444→/** Liquidation guard — adverse price move of 100/leverage % wipes the margin. */
   445→   445→export function liquidationHit(side: string, price: number, entry: number, leverage: number): boolean {
   446→   446→  if (leverage <= 1 || !entry || !price) return false;
   447→   447→  const move = side === "SHORT" ? ((entry - price) / entry) * 100 : ((price - entry) / entry) * 100;
   448→   448→  return move <= -(100 / leverage);
   449→   449→}
   450→   450→
   451→   451→/** Warn once the price has covered this share of the way to TP/SL (0..1) —
   452→   452→ *  giá trị sống ở ./params (re-export đầu file). */
   453→   453→
   454→   454→/** "tp" | "sl" | null — price is INSIDE the near-hit band but has NOT crossed yet. */
   455→   455→export function nearHit(side: string, price: number, entry: number, slPct: number, tpPct: number): "tp" | "sl" | null {
   456→   456→  if (!entry || !price) return null;
   457→   457→  const roe = roeOf(side, entry, price, 1); // price-move % (no leverage)
   458→   458→  const tp = Math.abs(tpPct);
   459→   459→  const sl = Math.abs(slPct);
   460→   460→  if (roe >= tp * NEAR_FRAC && roe < tp) return "tp";
   461→   461→  if (roe <= -sl * NEAR_FRAC && roe > -sl) return "sl";
   462→   462→  return null;
   463→   463→}
   464→   464→
   465→   465→// ─── Per-combo win-rate stats ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   466→   466→
   467→   467→export interface ComboStat {
   468→   468→  symbol: string;
   469→   469→  interval: string;
   470→   470→  closed: number;
   471→   471→  wins: number;
   472→   472→  /** wins / closed, % (1 decimal) */
   473→   473→  winRate: number;
   474→   474→  /** sum of ROE % over closed trades */
   475→   475→  netPnlPct: number;
   476→   476→  /** netPnlPct / closed */
   477→   477→  avgPnlPct: number;
   478→   478→}
   479→   479→
   480→   480→/** Aggregate closed trades into per (pair × timeframe) win-rate rows. */
   481→   481→export function comboStats(rows: Pick<AutoTradeRow, "symbol" | "interval" | "status" | "pnlPct">[]): ComboStat[] {
   482→   482→  const map = new Map<string, ComboStat>();
   483→   483→  for (const r of rows) {
   484→   484→    if (r.status !== "closed") continue;
   485→   485→    const key = `${r.symbol}|${r.interval}`;
   486→   486→    const s = map.get(key) ?? { symbol: r.symbol, interval: r.interval, closed: 0, wins: 0, winRate: 0, netPnlPct: 0, avgPnlPct: 0 };
   487→   487→    s.closed += 1;
   488→   488→    if ((r.pnlPct ?? 0) > 0) s.wins += 1;
   489→   489→    s.netPnlPct += r.pnlPct ?? 0;
   490→   490→    map.set(key, s);
   491→   491→  }
   492→   492→  const out = [...map.values()];
   493→   493→  for (const s of out) {
   494→   494→    s.netPnlPct = Math.round(s.netPnlPct * 100) / 100;
   495→   495→    s.winRate = s.closed > 0 ? Math.round((s.wins / s.closed) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
   496→   496→    s.avgPnlPct = s.closed > 0 ? Math.round((s.netPnlPct / s.closed) * 100) / 100 : 0;
   497→   497→  }
   498→   498→  return out.sort((a, b) => b.closed - a.closed || b.winRate - a.winRate);
   499→   499→}
   500→   500→
   501→   501→// ─── Position book (SQLite via /api/autotrade) ────────────────────────────────
   502→   502→
   503→   503→export interface AutoTradeRow {
   504→   504→  id: string;
   505→   505→  symbol: string;
   506→   506→  interval: string;
   507→   507→  side: string;
   508→   508→  entryPrice: number;
   509→   509→  entryTime: string;
   510→   510→  slPct: number;
   511→   511→  tpPct: number;
   512→   512→  leverage: number;
   513→   513→  /** share of equity staked on this trade, % (100 = all-in) */
   514→   514→  stakePct: number | null;
   515→   515→  status: string;
   516→   516→  exitPrice: number | null;
   517→   517→  exitTime: string | null;
   518→   518→  pnlPct: number | null;
   519→   519→  exitKind: string | null;
   520→   520→  prob: number | null;
   521→   521→  acc: number | null;
   522→   522→  auc: number | null;
   523→   523→  score: number | null;
   524→   524→  capitalBefore: number | null;
   525→   525→  capitalAfter: number | null;
   526→   526→  /** verdict LLM lúc vào lệnh — go | skip | unreachable (null = trước 0.2.28) */
   527→   527→  llmVerdict: string | null;
   528→   528→  /** lý do đầu tiên của verdict lúc vào lệnh */
   529→   529→  llmReason: string | null;
   530→   530→  /** JSON giải phẫu lệnh (autopsy) sau khi đóng — xem src/lib/autopsy.ts */
   531→   531→  autopsy: string | null;
   532→   532→  /** entry-policy fingerprint for self-improve agent */
   533→   533→  methodId: string | null;
   534→   534→  createdAt: string;
   535→   535→}

   561→   561→export async function openAutoTrade(payload: {
   562→   562→  symbol: string;
   563→   563→  interval: string;
   564→   564→  side: string;
   565→   565→  entryPrice: number;
   566→   566→  slPct: number;
   567→   567→  tpPct: number;
   568→   568→  leverage: number;
   569→   569→  /** equity share staked on this trade, % */
   570→   570→  stakePct: number;
   571→   571→  prob: number;
   572→   572→  acc: number;
   573→   573→  auc: number;
   574→   574→  score: number;
   575→   575→  capitalBefore: number;
   576→   576→}): Promise<AutoTradeRow | null> {
   577→   577→  try {
   578→   578→    const res = await fetch("/api/autotrade", {
   579→   579→      method: "POST",
   580→   580→      headers: jsonHeaders,
   581→   581→      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "open", ...payload }),
   582→   582→    });
   583→   583→    if (!res.ok) return null;
   584→   584→    const json = (await res.json()) as { trade: AutoTradeRow };
   585→   585→    return json.trade;
   586→   586→  } catch {
   587→   587→    return null;
   588→   588→  }
   589→   589→}

   591→   591→export async function closeAutoTrade(id: string, exitPrice: number, exitKind: string): Promise<AutoTradeRow | null> {
   592→   592→  try {

   594→   594→      method: "PATCH",
   595→   595→      headers: jsonHeaders,
   596→   596→      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "close", id, exitPrice, exitKind }),
   597→   597→    });
   598→   598→    if (!res.ok) return null;
   599→   599→    const json = (await res.json()) as { trade: AutoTradeRow };
   600→   600→    return json.trade;
   601→   601→  } catch {
   602→   602→    return null;
   603→   603→  }
   604→   604→}

   609→   609→      method: "PATCH",
   610→   610→      headers: jsonHeaders,
   611→   611→      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "reset" }),
   612→   612→    });

   614→   614→  } catch {
   615→   615→    return false;
   616→   616→  }

   619→   619→// ─── Telegram relay ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   621→   621→export async function telegramConfigured(): Promise<boolean> {
   622→   622→  try {
   623→   623→    const res = await fetch("/api/telegram");
   624→   624→    if (!res.ok) return false;
   625→   625→    const json = (await res.json()) as { configured: boolean };

   627→   627→  } catch {
   628→   628→    return false;

   631→   631→
   632→   632→export interface TgStatus {
   633→   633→  configured: boolean;
   634→   634→  chatId: string | null;
   635→   635→  /** where the config came from — always "env" (or null when unset) */
   636→   636→  source: "env" | null;
   637→   637→}
   638→   638→
   639→   639→/** Current telegram wiring (effective chat id included). */
   640→   640→export async function telegramStatus(): Promise<TgStatus> {
   641→   641→  try {
   642→   642→    const res = await fetch("/api/telegram");
   643→   643→    if (!res.ok) return { configured: false, chatId: null, source: null };
   644→   644→    return (await res.json()) as TgStatus;
   645→   645→  } catch {
   646→   646→    return { configured: false, chatId: null, source: null };
   647→   647→  }
   648→   648→}
   649→   649→
   650→   650→/** Consume a one-time ?tg=<secret> connect link (POST /api/telegram/link/connect) —
   651→   651→ *  installs the bound bot token server-side; the link burns after one use. */
   652→   652→export async function telegramLinkConnect(
   653→   653→  secret: string,
   654→   654→): Promise<{ ok: boolean; bot?: string | null; detail?: string }> {
   655→   655→  try {
   656→   656→    const res = await fetch("/api/telegram/link/connect", {
   657→   657→      method: "POST",
   658→   658→      headers: jsonHeaders,
   659→   659→      body: JSON.stringify({ secret }),
   660→   660→    });
   661→   661→    const json = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { ok?: boolean; bot?: string | null; error?: string } | null;
   662→   662→    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, detail: json?.error ?? `HTTP ${res.status}` };
   663→   663→    return { ok: json?.ok === true, bot: json?.bot ?? null };
   664→   664→  } catch (e) {
   665→   665→    return { ok: false, detail: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "fetch failed" };
   666→   666→  }
   667→   667→}
   668→   668→
   669→   669→/**
   670→   670→ * Fire-and-forget notification — resolves {ok:false, detail} instead of throwing.
   671→   671→ * `html: true` (default) sends with parse_mode HTML — templates must escape
   672→   672→ * raw < > & themselves (pair names / numbers never contain them).
   673→   673→ * `key` — semantic dedupe id (open:<tradeId>, near:<id>:tp, top:<5min-bucket>, …):
   674→   674→ * many tabs/devices share one Telegram channel, the SERVER suppresses repeats
   675→   675→ * of the same event (TG_DEDUPE_MS window) — 20 sessions → one message.
   676→   676→ * `dedupe: false` — bypass for manual sends (the "Kiểm tra" test button).
   677→   677→ */
   678→   678→export async function sendTelegram(
   679→   679→  text: string,
   680→   680→  opts?: { html?: boolean; key?: string; dedupe?: boolean },
   681→   681→): Promise<{ ok: boolean; detail?: string }> {
   682→   682→  try {
   683→   683→    const res = await fetch("/api/telegram", {
   684→   684→      method: "POST",
   685→   685→      headers: jsonHeaders,
   686→   686→      body: JSON.stringify({
   687→   687→        text,
   688→   688→        parse_mode: opts?.html === false ? undefined : "HTML",
   689→   689→        key: opts?.key,
   690→   690→        dedupe: opts?.dedupe,
   691→   691→      }),
   692→   692→    });
   693→   693→    if (!res.ok) {
   694→   694→      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { detail?: string } | null;
   695→   695→      return { ok: false, detail: json?.detail ?? `HTTP ${res.status}` };
   696→   696→    }
   697→   697→    return { ok: true };
   698→   698→  } catch (e) {
   699→   699→    return { ok: false, detail: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "fetch failed" };
   700→   700→  }
   701→   701→}
   702→   702→
   703→   703→// ─── Periodic stats digest (hourly / daily Telegram reports) ────────────────
   704→   704→
   705→   705→const DIGEST_HR = "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━";
   706→   706→const sideTag = (side: string): string => (side === "LONG" ? "LONG 🟢" : side === "SHORT" ? "SHORT 🔴" : "NEUTRAL ⚪");
   707→   707→/** Số dòng tối đa của mục "Lệnh đã chạy" — giữ digest dưới trần 4096 ký tự Telegram */
   708→   708→const DIGEST_LIST_MAX = 40;
   709→   709→/** exitKind → icon kết quả (null/không rõ = ✋ đóng tay) */
   710→   710→const DIGEST_KIND: Record<string, string> = { tp: "✅", sl: "🔻", flip: "🔄", manual: "✋" };
   711→   711→
   712→   712→/**
   713→   713→ * Digest body — counts OPENS as well as closes inside the window (an hourly
   714→   714→ * report saying "0 lệnh" right after a fresh open reads as broken), and shows
   715→   715→ * "—" instead of a fake 0% win rate while nothing has settled yet.
   716→   716→ * Built server-side (see /api/autotrade/push) so every open tab/device shares
   717→   717→ * one exactly-once sender.
   718→   718→ */
   719→   719→export function statLines(st: AutoState, sinceMs: number, title: string, periodLabel: string): string[] {
   720→   720→  const recent = st.trades.filter((x) => x.status === "closed" && x.exitTime && new Date(x.exitTime).getTime() >= sinceMs);
   721→   721→  const opened = st.trades.filter((x) => new Date(x.entryTime).getTime() >= sinceMs);
   722→   722→  const wins = recent.filter((x) => (x.pnlPct ?? 0) > 0).length;
   723→   723→  const net = recent.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.pnlPct ?? 0), 0);
   724→   724→  const wr = recent.length ? `${Math.round((wins / recent.length) * 100)}%` : "—";
   725→   725→  const roe = recent.length ? `${net >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${net.toFixed(2)}%` : "—";
   726→   726→  const lines = [
   727→   727→    title,
   728→   728→    DIGEST_HR,
   729→   729→    `📊 ${periodLabel}: <b>${opened.length} opened</b> · <b>${recent.length} closed</b> · Win rate <b>${wr}</b> · Net ROE <b>${roe}</b>`,
   730→   730→  ];
   731→   731→  if (st.open) lines.push(`🔓 Holding: <b>#${st.open.symbol}</b> ${st.open.interval} ${sideTag(st.open.side)} @ ${fmtPrice(st.open.entryPrice)}`);
   732→   732→  lines.push(
   733→   733→    `💰 Equity: <b>${st.capital != null ? st.capital.toFixed(2) : "—"}</b> USDT · Total ${st.stats.closed} closed${st.open ? " · 1 still open" : ""} · WR ${st.stats.closed ? `${st.stats.winRate.toFixed(0)}%` : "—"}`,
   734→   734→  );
   735→   735→  const best = (st.byCombo ?? []).filter((c) => c.closed >= 3).sort((a, b) => b.winRate - a.winRate)[0];
   736→   736→  if (best) lines.push(`🏆 Best combo: <b>#${best.symbol}</b> ${best.interval} · WR ${best.winRate.toFixed(0)}% (${best.closed} trades)`);
   737→   737→
   738→   738→  // 📋 List tổng — MỌI lệnh đã đóng (mới nhất trước), mỗi lệnh một dòng kèm
   739→   739→  // kết quả (TP/SL/flip/đóng tay) + ROE + giờ đóng (giờ kênh Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
   740→   740→  // Giới hạn DIGEST_LIST_MAX dòng, phần cũ gộp một dòng để không vượt 4096 ký tự.
   741→   741→  // Lệnh đang mở không nằm đây — đã có dòng "🔓 Đang giữ" ở trên.
   742→   742→  const closedAll = st.trades
   743→   743→    .filter((x) => x.status === "closed")
   744→   744→    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.exitTime ?? b.entryTime).getTime() - new Date(a.exitTime ?? a.entryTime).getTime());
   745→   745→  if (closedAll.length) {
   746→   746→    const fmtT = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
   747→   747→      timeZone: "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh",
   748→   748→      day: "2-digit",
   749→   749→      month: "2-digit",
   750→   750→      hour: "2-digit",
   751→   751→      minute: "2-digit",
   752→   752→      hour12: false,
   753→   753→    });
   754→   754→    lines.push(`📋 <b>Trades executed (${closedAll.length})</b> · newest first:`);
   755→   755→    for (const x of closedAll.slice(0, DIGEST_LIST_MAX)) {
   756→   756→      const pnl = x.pnlPct ?? 0;
   757→   757→      lines.push(
   758→   758→        `• #${x.symbol} ${x.interval} ${sideTag(x.side)} ${DIGEST_KIND[x.exitKind ?? ""] ?? "✋"} <b>${pnl >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${pnl.toFixed(2)}%</b> · ${fmtT.format(new Date(x.exitTime ?? x.entryTime))}`,
   759→   759→      );
   760→   760→    }
   761→   761→    if (closedAll.length > DIGEST_LIST_MAX) lines.push(`…and ${closedAll.length - DIGEST_LIST_MAX} older trades`);
   762→   762→  }
   763→   763→  return lines;
   764→   764→}
   765→   765→
   766→   766→/** Trigger the server-side digest sender — dedupe/boundary logic lives there. */
   767→   767→export async function pushAutoStats(body: { hourly?: boolean; daily?: boolean; force?: boolean }): Promise<boolean> {
   768→   768→  try {
   769→   769→    const res = await fetch("/api/autotrade/push", { method: "POST", headers: jsonHeaders, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
   770→   770→    return res.ok;
   771→   771→  } catch {
   772→   772→    return false;
   773→   773→  }
   774→   774→}
   775→   775→
   776→   776→// ─── Config (localStorage) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   777→   777→
   778→   778→export const AUTO_LS_KEY = "utp.auto";
   779→   779→
   780→   780→export interface AutoConfig {
   781→   781→  on: boolean;
   782→   782→  /** dry-run starting equity, USDT */
   783→   783→  capital: number;
   784→   784→  /** share of equity staked per trade, % (100 = all-in) */
   785→   785→  riskPct: number;
   786→   786→  /** TP/SL source: "atr" = live ATR × coef measured at entry time (default),
   787→   787→   *  "auto" = the scan row's train-time ATR levels, "manual" = fixed */
   788→   788→  tpMode: "atr" | "auto" | "manual";
   789→   789→  /** manual SL % (price move, before leverage) — used when tpMode = manual */
   790→   790→  slPct: number;
   791→   791→  /** manual TP % (price move, before leverage) — used when tpMode = manual */
   792→   792→  tpPct: number;
   793→   793→  /** ATR × multiplier for live entry levels — used when tpMode = "atr" and the
   794→   794→   *  scan row carries no retrained coef; 1.5 ≈ the classic ATR stop */
   795→   795→  atrCoef: number;
   796→   796→  /** cycle interval, minutes */
   797→   797→  cycleMin: number;
   798→   798→  /** các khung giờ engine CHẠY (scan + train + vào lệnh) — bật tắt trên panel;
   799→   799→   *  khung tắt bị bỏ hẳn khỏi vòng quét/train kế tiếp */
   800→   800→  runTf: string[];
   801→   801→  /** NGƯỠNG CHẤT LƯỢNG CHUNG — một bộ ba setpoint duy nhất áp cho MỌI tầng: mở
   802→   802→   *  lệnh, bù DCA và đăng broadcast (gateRow). Chỉnh một chỗ trên Auto panel. */
   803→   803→  minAuc: number;
   804→   804→  minAcc: number;
   805→   805→  /** min score (= (AUC−0.5)×100 + (ACC−50) + tin cậy×15) — lọc model đạt ngưỡng
   806→   806→   *  metrics nhưng thiếu tự tin */
   807→   807→  minScore: number;
   808→   808→  /** wait after an SL exit on the same combo, minutes (0 = off) */
   809→   809→  cooldownMin: number;
   810→   810→  /** max DCA adds into a losing position while the model still confirms the
   811→   811→   *  direction — each add averages the entry and re-anchors SL/TP on the new
   812→   812→   *  average (0 = off; the SL then closes the position as before) */
   813→   813→  dcaMax: number;
   814→   814→  /** auto-post a stats digest to Telegram at the top of every hour */
   815→   815→  statHourly: boolean;
   816→   816→  /** auto-post a stats digest to Telegram once a day */
   817→   817→  statDaily: boolean;
   818→   818→  /** base URL of the llama-server endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.8:8888 —
   819→   819→   *  the risk officer runs silently in the backend (no UI toggle) */
   820→   820→  llmUrl: string;
   821→   821→  /** model name sent with each request (informational — the server binds one model) */
   822→   822→  llmModel: string;
   823→   823→  /** seconds to wait for one LLM call (10–600). Overrides params LLM_TIMEOUT_MS when set. */
   824→   824→  llmTimeoutSec: number;
   825→   825→  /** true = skip entries when LLM is down; false = fail-OPEN (enter on XGB alone) */
   826→   826→  llmFailClosed: boolean;
   827→   827→  /** skip auto-entries whose last closed candle is a whale bar (≥4σ volume) */
   828→   828→  whaleFilter: boolean;
   829→   829→  /** broadcast the "TOP coin tiềm năng" scan digest to Telegram every 5 min */
   830→   830→  broadcast: boolean;
   831→   831→  /** LẬT CHIỀU TỰ ĐỘNG — khi lệnh đang mở và scan mới của CÙNG cặp/khung đảo
   832→   832→   *  chiều với tín hiệu đạt đủ ngưỡng chất lượng (cùng gate vào lệnh + noise band
   833→   833→   *  + không regressed), engine đóng lệnh cũ (exitKind "flip") và mở lệnh
   834→   834→   *  ngược chiều NGAY trong chu kỳ đó. Thị trường luôn biến động — dự báo chỉ
   835→   835→   *  là dự báo; flip là cách bot theo kịch. false = giữ lệnh tới TP/SL. */
   836→   836→  autoFlip: boolean;
   837→   837→}
   838→   838→
   839→   839→export const AUTO_DEFAULTS: AutoConfig = {
   840→   840→  on: false,
   841→   841→  capital: 1000,
   842→   842→  riskPct: 25,
   843→   843→  tpMode: "atr",
   844→   844→  slPct: 1,
   845→   845→  tpPct: 1.5,
   846→   846→  atrCoef: 1.5,
   847→   847→  cycleMin: 5,
   848→   848→  runTf: [...INTERVALS],
   849→   849→  // ngưỡng chung mặc định = setpoint broadcast 31/10 (60 / 0.8 / 70) — đồng bộ
   850→   850→  // BCAST_* trong bcast-gate.ts; migration từ 0.55/55 thời "no UI" nằm ở
   851→   851→  // loadAutoConfig + engine.loadEngine
   852→   852→  minAuc: 0.8,
   853→   853→  minAcc: 70,
   854→   854→  minScore: 60,
   855→   855→  cooldownMin: 30,
   856→   856→  dcaMax: 1,
   857→   857→  statHourly: true,
   858→   858→  statDaily: true,
   859→   859→  llmUrl: LLM_URL_DEFAULT,
   860→   860→  llmModel: LLM_MODEL_DEFAULT,
   861→   861→  llmTimeoutSec: 90,
   862→   862→  llmFailClosed: false,
   863→   863→  whaleFilter: true,
   864→   864→  broadcast: true,
   865→   865→  autoFlip: true,
   866→   866→};
   867→   867→export const COOLDOWN_CHOICES = [0, 15, 30, 60] as const;
   868→   868→/** DCA adds allowed into a losing position (model still confirming) */
   869→   869→export const DCA_CHOICES = [0, 1, 2] as const;
   870→   870→export const RISK_CHOICES = [10, 25, 50, 100] as const;
   871→   871→export const TP_MODES = ["atr", "auto", "manual"] as const;
   872→   872→
   873→   873→/** auto-trade rescan cycle choices — minutes + display label ("1w" = 1 tuần) */
   874→   874→export const CYCLE_CHOICES = [
   875→   875→  { m: 5, label: "5" },
   876→   876→  { m: 10, label: "10" },
   877→   877→  { m: 15, label: "15" },
   878→   878→  { m: 30, label: "30" },
   879→   879→  { m: 60, label: "1h" },
   880→   880→  { m: 240, label: "4h" },
   881→   881→  { m: 1440, label: "1d" },
   882→   882→  { m: 10080, label: "1w" },
   883→   883→] as const;
   884→   884→
   885→   885→/** Chuẩn hoá danh sách khung giờ chạy: chỉ nhận member hợp lệ của INTERVALS,
   886→   886→ *  sắp theo thứ tự gốc, trùng thì gộp — rỗng/toàn sai thì trả về tất cả
   887→   887→ *  (không bao giờ để engine chạy 0 khung). */
   888→   888→export function sanitizeRunTf(v: unknown): string[] {
   889→   889→  const set = new Set(
   890→   890→    (Array.isArray(v) ? v : []).filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string" && (INTERVALS as readonly string[]).includes(x)),
   891→   891→  );
   892→   892→  const list = INTERVALS.filter((i) => set.has(i));
   893→   893→  return list.length ? [...list] : [...INTERVALS];
   894→   894→}
   895→   895→
   896→   896→/** Kẹp bộ ba NGƯỠNG CHẤT LƯỢNG CHUNG vào vùng hợp lệ — dùng ở MỌI cửa nhận cfg
   897→   897→ *  (localStorage, engine.json, POST /api/engine sync) để không đường nào đánh
   898→   898→ *  lọt giá trị lệch. Migration: bộ 0.55/55 là default thời minAuc/minAcc còn
   899→   899→ *  "no UI" (trước 1/11) — chưa từng được chỉnh tay nên nâng thẳng lên ngưỡng
   900→   900→ *  chung mới thay vì giữ lại. */
   901→   901→export function sanitizeFloors(
   902→   902→  auc: unknown,
   903→   903→  acc: unknown,
   904→   904→  score: unknown,
   905→   905→): { minAuc: number; minAcc: number; minScore: number } {
   906→   906→  const legacy = auc === 0.55 && acc === 55;
   907→   907→  const num = (x: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, dflt: number): number =>
   908→   908→    typeof x === "number" && Number.isFinite(x) ? Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x)) : dflt;
   909→   909→  return {
   910→   910→    minAuc: legacy ? AUTO_DEFAULTS.minAuc : num(auc, 0.5, 0.95, AUTO_DEFAULTS.minAuc),
   911→   911→    minAcc: legacy ? AUTO_DEFAULTS.minAcc : num(acc, 50, 90, AUTO_DEFAULTS.minAcc),
   912→   912→    minScore: num(score, 0, 95, AUTO_DEFAULTS.minScore),
   913→   913→  };
   914→   914→}
   915→   915→
   916→   916→export function loadAutoConfig(): AutoConfig {
   917→   917→  try {
   918→   918→    const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTO_LS_KEY);
   919→   919→    if (!raw) return AUTO_DEFAULTS;
   920→   920→    const p = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<AutoConfig>;
   921→   921→    return {
   922→   922→      on: p.on === true,
   923→   923→      capital: typeof p.capital === "number" && p.capital > 0 ? p.capital : AUTO_DEFAULTS.capital,
   924→   924→      riskPct: RISK_CHOICES.includes(p.riskPct as (typeof RISK_CHOICES)[number]) ? (p.riskPct as number) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.riskPct,
   925→   925→      tpMode: p.tpMode === "manual" ? "manual" : p.tpMode === "auto" ? "auto" : "atr",
   926→   926→      slPct: typeof p.slPct === "number" ? Math.min(20, Math.max(0.2, p.slPct)) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.slPct,
   927→   927→      tpPct: typeof p.tpPct === "number" ? Math.min(30, Math.max(0.2, p.tpPct)) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.tpPct,
   928→   928→      atrCoef: typeof p.atrCoef === "number" && p.atrCoef > 0 ? Math.min(5, Math.max(0.5, p.atrCoef)) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.atrCoef,
   929→   929→      cycleMin: CYCLE_CHOICES.some((c) => c.m === p.cycleMin) ? (p.cycleMin as number) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.cycleMin,
   930→   930→      // ngưỡng chung — kẹp + migration legacy trong sanitizeFloors (một nguồn)
   931→   931→      ...sanitizeFloors(p.minAuc, p.minAcc, p.minScore),
   932→   932→      cooldownMin: COOLDOWN_CHOICES.includes(p.cooldownMin as 0 | 15 | 30 | 60)
   933→   933→        ? (p.cooldownMin as number)
   934→   934→        : AUTO_DEFAULTS.cooldownMin,
   935→   935→      dcaMax: DCA_CHOICES.includes(p.dcaMax as 0 | 1 | 2) ? (p.dcaMax as number) : AUTO_DEFAULTS.dcaMax,
   936→   936→      runTf: sanitizeRunTf(p.runTf),
   937→   937→      statHourly: p.statHourly !== false,
   938→   938→      statDaily: p.statDaily !== false,
   939→   939→      llmUrl:
   940→   940→        typeof p.llmUrl === "string" && /^https?:\/\/\S{1,120}$/.test(p.llmUrl.trim()) ? p.llmUrl.trim() : AUTO_DEFAULTS.llmUrl,
   941→   941→      llmModel: typeof p.llmModel === "string" && p.llmModel.length <= 60 ? p.llmModel : AUTO_DEFAULTS.llmModel,
   942→   942→      llmTimeoutSec:
   943→   943→        typeof p.llmTimeoutSec === "number" && p.llmTimeoutSec >= 10 && p.llmTimeoutSec <= 600
   944→   944→          ? Math.round(p.llmTimeoutSec)
   945→   945→          : AUTO_DEFAULTS.llmTimeoutSec,
   946→   946→      llmFailClosed: p.llmFailClosed === true,
   947→   947→      whaleFilter: p.whaleFilter !== false,
   948→   948→      broadcast: p.broadcast !== false,
   949→   949→      autoFlip: p.autoFlip !== false,
   950→   950→    };
   951→   951→  } catch {
   952→   952→    return AUTO_DEFAULTS;
   953→   953→  }
   954→   954→}
   955→   955→
   956→   956→export function saveAutoConfig(cfg: AutoConfig): void {
   957→   957→  try {
   958→   958→    localStorage.setItem(AUTO_LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg));
   959→   959→  } catch {
   960→   960→    // storage blocked — config lives for this session only
   961→   961→  }
   962→   962→}
   963→   963→
